exercise.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
library_steps: Face a sturdy bench or box, holding a dumbbell at each side.
Place one foot fully on the box and push through it to stand up.
Step down slowly with the same leg; switch legs after your set.
exercise.one_line_summary: Dumbbells at the sides, left foot flat on a ~40 cm box with the knee bent about 85 deg (start), then standing tall on the box with both feet (end).

setup.target: About 40 cm: high enough that the knee is near 90 deg with the foot on top.
Dumbbells at the sides, palms in, shoulder blades down and back, torso upright.
Whole foot on the box; knee over the second toe.

movement.start: about 85 deg, foot on the box, shin near vertical
movement.end: about 5 deg, standing tall on the box

movement.start: on the floor, knee soft (~18 deg)
movement.end: beside the left foot on the box

movement.tolerance: dumbbells clear of box and thighs

muscles.role: Extends the lead knee. Vastus lateralis/medialis were the most active muscles on a 40 cm lateral step-up (S1).
Extends the hip; forward step-up 54.7% MVIC (S2).
Assist hip extension; biceps femoris lowest of the measured muscles (S1).
Holds the pelvis level on one leg; forward step-up 54.6% MVIC (S2).

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Lead knee falls inside the foot as he pushes up.
Big bounce from the floor leg; lead leg does little.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Takes the work off the lead quads and glutes.

sources.citation: Muyor JM, Martin-Fuentes I, Rodriguez-Ridao D, Antequera-Vique JA. 2020. Electromyographic activity ... during the Monopodal Squat, Forward Lunge and Lateral Step-Up exercises. PLoS One 15(4):e0230841.
sources.what_it_gave: 40 cm box; VL 197, VM 217, RF 198 vs GMed 117, GMax 98, BF 92 (mean concentric mV).

sources.citation: Boren K, Conrey C, Le Coguic J, et al. 2011. Electromyographic analysis of gluteus medius and gluteus maximus during rehabilitation exercises. Int J Sports Phys Ther 6(3):206-223.
sources.what_it_gave: Forward step-up glut med 54.6, glut max 54.7 % MVIC; lateral step-up 59.9 / 63.8.

sources.citation: American Council on Exercise. Step-Up (exercise library).
sources.what_it_gave: Dumbbells palms in, foot planted, torso upright, knee over second toe, avoid foot/ankle collapsing, step down with control.

clip_check.check: Lead knee flexion in start picture
Lead foot flat on box top in both pictures
Trail foot flat on floor (start) / on box (end)
End: knees near straight, pelvis over the box
Hands on handles, dumbbells not inside box or thigh
Quads the strongest red in both pictures
